hook: Your selfie here can be on the edge.
title: Your Selfie Can Be on a Waterfall's Edge
description:
At Victoria Falls on the Zambia-Zimbabwe border, the Devil's Pool is a natural rock pool right at the edge of the drop. It is only reachable when the river runs low. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #VictoriaFalls #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Would you swim here? Yes or no
